name: Variation-selector run after one emoji in a tool response, matching no signature
notes: The presence floor on the carriers the hidden-character detector skips (retrieved data is full of benign invisible characters). Fires on a run of TWO OR MORE selectors only, because no standardized variation sequence contains two; a single emoji VS16 is what real data is full of and stays silent. There is no decode-and-rescan pass, so this reports the concealment, never what it says. Warn, not block. #114.
